name: tic-tac-toe
description: Real-time multiplayer Tic Tac Toe — root workspace orchestrating backend (Express + Socket.IO) and frontend (React + Vite + Tailwind).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
